constraints.constraint_text: Use the approved teal-and-charcoal palette and keep the Northline Arc wordmark clear of other copy.
constraints.applies_to: The billboard and station-panel creative, including its palette and Northline Arc wordmark.
constraints.restriction_details: Use the approved teal-and-charcoal palette; keep the wordmark clear of other copy.

constraints.constraint_text: Any panel that mentions the 12-year warranty must include the exact line, "Warranty terms apply; see product documentation."
constraints.applies_to: Any panel that mentions the 12-year warranty.
constraints.restriction_details: Include the exact line: "Warranty terms apply; see product documentation."

constraints.constraint_text: Do not use "guaranteed zero energy bills" or wording that implies every household will eliminate its utility costs.
constraints.applies_to: Claims about household energy bills or utility costs.
constraints.restriction_details: Do not use the specified phrase or wording that implies every household will eliminate its utility costs.

constraints.constraint_text: Do not place the creative within 200 metres of schools or on panels facing a school entrance.
constraints.restriction_details: Exclude placements within 200 metres of schools and panels facing a school entrance.

source_instruction: For the Northline Arc home battery billboard and station-panel creative, use the approved teal-and-charcoal palette and keep the Northline Arc wordmark clear of other copy. Any panel that mentions the 12-year warranty must include the exact line, "Warranty terms apply; see product documentation." Do not use "guaranteed zero energy bills" or wording that implies every household will eliminate its utility costs. Do not place the creative within 200 metres of schools or on panels facing a school entrance.

constraints.constraint_text: Use the approved cream-and-cobalt palette and show the Solstice model name in the same panel as the product image.
constraints.applies_to: The roadside billboard creative, including its palette, model name, and product image.
constraints.restriction_details: Use the approved cream-and-cobalt palette and place the model name in the same panel as the product image.

constraints.constraint_text: If the advertised price appears, include the exact line, "Price shown is for the base configuration; accessories sold separately."
constraints.applies_to: Creative that displays the advertised price.
constraints.restriction_details: Include the exact line: "Price shown is for the base configuration; accessories sold separately."

constraints.constraint_text: Do not call the bike "maintenance-free" or "risk-free."
constraints.restriction_details: Do not use either of the specified expressions to describe the bike.

constraints.constraint_text: Run the creative only on roadside billboards with posted speed limits of 40 mph or lower; exclude digital screens in pedestrian crossings.
constraints.restriction_details: Use only roadside billboards where the posted speed limit is 40 mph or lower; do not use digital screens in pedestrian crossings.

source_instruction: For the Solstice e-bike roadside billboard campaign, use the approved cream-and-cobalt palette and show the Solstice model name in the same panel as the product image. If the advertised price appears, include the exact line, "Price shown is for the base configuration; accessories sold separately." Do not call the bike "maintenance-free" or "risk-free." Run the creative only on roadside billboards with posted speed limits of 40 mph or lower; exclude digital screens in pedestrian crossings.
